verdict.rationale: Mods let the agent add "event hooks" and permission policies to its own runtime, but these run as trusted code rather than a declarative rules system. Adjacent automation comes from scheduled tasks (time-based, not event-based), dreaming triggers (after N steps or on context compaction), and Slack mentions that wake always-on agents. missing for 10: a documented user-facing rule/trigger configuration (event → action) without writing mod code, a catalog of supported hook events, and independent or hands-on corroboration that event-driven automation works.
